about: Sources of the dissertation citation graph, read in this order by scripts/dissertation_ingest.py. Paths: absolute, 'data/...' from the repository root, or bare names inside this directory. Globs allowed. 'ingest': false = read and report only. 'verify_existing': the adapter must reproduce the existing manifest entries exactly (reported as present_identical).
